findings.text: Flake: first two `make display-audit-crew` runs (fresh clone, right after import) failed in the playthrough with 'current-ship-startup: FAIL live-rest deck-view single-navigation' then SCRIPT ERROR at m4_playthrough_ship.gd:481 (demo.journey_sim nil). Reproducible twice in the audit target, but base-version and branch playthroughs run directly passed, and the third audit run passed. Not in the diff (plain-launch path); probably cold-state/startup timing. Unexplained; watch nightly.
Count guard `test $$n -eq 4` is redundant with `bad` except when a ctl line is deleted; deleting a ctl AND the count survives (expected, joint mutation).
Harness reads private BridgeMonitor._view/_receiver/_bed; a rename in PR #412-like work breaks it loudly (script error), acceptable.
AC10 (playthrough-negative/adversarial), AC13 by inspection only, not re-run.

root_cause_judgement: Faithful. In play BridgeMonitor._process refreshes the face (face.refresh(_view,...)) at 10/30 Hz whenever on screen, and ship_geometry_demo._refresh_monitors feeds _view each frame (line 1339/1544). A face a player sees is therefore always refreshed within 0.1 s; unrefreshed only while off screen (not visible). The harness disables every _process, so supplying face.refresh from the demo-given _view models play. No product bug hidden. Residual: the sub-100ms first-on-screen blank is not covered by the audit, and the audit does not render viewports.
